posts.text: I am pleased to nominate Jim O’Neill to serve as Judge on the United States District Court for the Middle District of North Carolina. Jim has the strong support of both North Carolina Senators, Ted Budd and Thom Tillis. Jim has served as the District Attorney of Forsyth County since 2009, and has been a prosecutor in that office since 1997.
